title: The routing rules
description: What routing-rules.yml holds in a directory that `ingestion connectors apply` sends. Each rule names one destination for the items that match it. The side gate reads the rules in order, after the tags, and the first rule that holds places the item.

match.description: What the rule holds for. Each condition it names must hold on one of the item's sightings, and it names at least one.

connector.description: Holds for an item this connector sighted. The set declares the connector.

tag.description: Holds for an item a sighting tagged with this.

field.description: A field of the source's payload, as the connector's format records it on each sighting, such as a Reddit save's subreddit.

values.description: The values of field the rule holds for, each matched exactly.

destination.description: The destination for the items the rule's match holds for, which destinations.yml declares.
